title: doppeldata manifest v1
description: The record of a generated dataset, which with its profile regenerates every file byte for byte.

dataset_digest.description: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of `identity`'s RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

destination.description: Where the files were written, as the caller named it, such as `s3://bucket/orders/`.

files.description: Every object written, in path order.

partial.description:
True when the run stopped early, so `files` lists only the objects that completed. Such a
manifest is stored as `_manifest.partial.json`, and regenerates nothing.

scenario.description: The scenario applied, or null for none.

threads.description: The threads that generated and encoded. The count never changes a byte.

tool.description:
The tool that wrote the files, as `doppeldata <version>`. The files' bytes are a function of
the identity and this version.

written_at.description: When the write finished, in RFC 3339.

oneOf.description: One JSON array of objects per file.

Decimal.description: A 64-bit unsigned integer in decimal, because a JSON number is exact only to 2^53.

DelimitedSettings.description: A CSV or TSV dialect. Every character must be ASCII.

bom.description: Whether the file starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark.

compression_level.description: The codec's level, which must fall in the codec's range. Null takes the codec's default.

date_format.description: A chrono format for date columns. Null writes ISO 8601.

delimiter.description: Null takes the format's own: `,` for CSV, a tab for TSV.

escape.description: The character that escapes a quote inside a quoted field. Null doubles the quote instead.

header.description: Whether the first line names the columns.

null.description:
What a null prints where the column's profile gives no missing token for it. When it is
empty, an empty string is quoted so the two read back apart.

time_format.description: A chrono format for time columns. Null writes ISO 8601.

timestamp_format.description: A chrono format for timestamp columns without a time zone. Null writes ISO 8601.

timestamp_tz_format.description: A chrono format for timestamp columns with a time zone. Null writes ISO 8601 with the offset.

FileRows.description: The rows each object holds, before a range is scaled by its partition values.

anyOf.description: The same count in every range but the last.

Each range's count drawn from these quantiles, from a stream keyed by the seed, so the
split is the same on every run.

compression_level.description: The codec's level, which must fall in the codec's range. Null takes the codec's default.

explicit_nulls.description: Whether a null field is written as `null` rather than left out.

LayoutSettings.description: How rows are split into files and directories.

partition_by.description:
The columns whose values name each object's directories, outermost first. A partition
column is left out of the files, because its value is in the path.

partition_values.description:
The values the partition keys take together, as the profile counts them. A range holds
`file_rows` times this, so each of its objects lands near `file_rows` rows.

ManifestFile.description:
One object the run wrote. A row or byte count is a JSON number, exact to 2^53 rows, which no
dataset reaches.

first_row.description: The dataset row the range starts at.

partition.description:
Each partition key's value in the object's path, null for a null value. Absent when the
dataset is not partitioned.

path.description: The object's path under the destination, `/`-separated.

range.description: The index of the row range the object holds, which its file name also carries.

range_rows.description: The rows the range holds. A partitioned range splits them across one object per value.

sha256.description: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of the object's bytes.

ManifestIdentity.description:
The values a dataset's rows are a pure function of, keyed and written as the identity's canonical
JSON, so a reader rebuilds `dataset_digest` from them with no mapping.

dataset_rows.description: The dataset's row count, in decimal.

profile_digest.description: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of the profile's RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

scenario_digest.description: The scenario's digest, or null for none.

path.description: The profile's path as the caller gave it, or null when it came from memory.

version.description: The profile format version it was read as.

path.description: The scenario's path as the caller gave it, or null when it came from memory.

ManifestVersion.description: The manifest format version, which changes only on a breaking format change.

oneOf.description: LZ4_RAW, the LZ4 codec current readers expect.

compression_level.description: The codec's level, which must fall in the codec's range. Null takes the codec's default.

dictionary_columns.description: The columns written with a dictionary. Null gives every column one.

row_group_rows.description: The most rows a row group holds.

timestamp_unit.description:
The unit every timestamp column is cast to. Null keeps each column's own. parquet's Arrow
writer cannot write INT96, so no unit reproduces it.

ParquetStatistics.description: How much of the min, max and null count each column chunk records.

oneOf.description: Per page too, with the page index.
Bare value directories, one level per key.

Quantiles.description: Values at named quantiles: p05 is the 5th percentile, p50 the median, p999 the 99.9th. The digits after p are the level's decimal digits, at least two and never ending in 0 past the second.

Quoting.description: Which fields are quoted. A null is never quoted.

oneOf.description:
Only a field holding the delimiter, the quote or a line break, and an empty string where a
null prints empty.
Every field that does not parse as a number.
None, even where a field needs it.
windows-1252, the superset of ISO-8859-1 every decoder applies to a `latin1` label.
